name: Helping My Lord!
source:
With the deadline approaching, you need to take care of your Lord with activities such as cleaning, cooking and even going to the shop. Give your all with your chores but remember to take care of yourself!

[From [url=https://kirimaruwm.itch.io/helping-my-lord]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
随着最后期限的临近，你需要照顾你的主，比如打扫卫生、做饭，甚至去商店。全力以赴做好家务，但记得照顾好自己！

[来自[url=https://kirimaruwm.itch.io/helping-my-lord]itch.io[/url]]
